# Karen Rebeca Ortiz

> Product engineer between design and code. I design and build AI-powered web products end to end — frontend, backend, AI integrations (MCP, agents, automation), design systems, and infrastructure. Based in Mexico; working remotely with teams in LATAM, the US, and Europe.
